title: Estimating Long-term Heterogeneous Dose-response Curve: Generalization Bound Leveraging Optimal Transport Weights
abstract: arXiv:2406.19195v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-term treatment effect estimation is a significant but challenging problem in many applications. Existing methods rely on ideal assumptions, such as no unobserved confounders or binary treatment, to estimate long-term average treatment effects. However, in numerous real-world applications, these assumptions could be violated, and average treatment effects are insufficient for personalized decision-making. In this paper, we address a more general problem of estimating long-term Heterogeneous Dose-Response Curve (HDRC) while accounting for unobserved confounders and continuous treatment. translated_title: 估计长期异质性剂量-反应曲线：利用最优传输权重的泛化边界
translated_abstract: 长期治疗效应估计在许多应用中是一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。现有方法依赖于理想假设，例如不存在未观测混杂因素或处理为二元变量，来估计长期平均治疗效应。然而，在众多现实应用中，这些假设可能不成立，且平均治疗效应不足以支持个性化决策。在本文中，我们解决了一个更一般的问题，即在考虑未观测混杂因素和连续处理的情况下，估计长期异质性剂量-反应曲线（HDRC）。具体而言，为了消除长期观测数据中的未观测混杂因素，我们引入了一个最优传输加权框架，将长期观测数据与辅助的短期实验数据进行对齐。此外，为了准确预测连续处理的异质性效应，我们建立了一个泛化边界……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于最优传输加权的框架，通过将长期观测数据与辅助短期实验数据对齐来消除未观测混杂因素的影响，从而在连续处理条件下估计长期异质性剂量-反应曲线并建立泛化误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal transport weighting framework that aligns long-term observational data with auxiliary short-term experimental data to remove unobserved confounders, enabling estimation of long-term heterogeneous dose-response curves under continuous treatments with established generalization bounds.
